description: One scanned account. id_b64 and username_b64 are URL-safe base64 without padding: obfuscation against casual search for a trusted research group, reversible by anyone, not anonymity. No scores are stored here; an evidence file may hold the signals.

event_id.description: The outage event (an id of events.toml); equal to the name of the events/<event_id>/ folder holding the record.

evidence.description: Evidence file, relative to the event folder: evidence/<platform>/<id_b64>.md. Required for verified_inauthentic.

id_b64.description: Stable platform ID, URL-safe base64 without padding.

last_activity_at.description: Newest own activity seen at scan time.

last_scanned_at.description: Reference time (now) of the newest scan that saw the account.

scan_window_end.description: Where the scanned data ended (the source's data horizon, or the scan time for a live source).

username_b64.description: Handle at the last scan, URL-safe base64 without padding.

title: Registry record
